chapters.title: Your gym becomes a private assessment studio.

blocks.title: A scan members remember
blocks.body: 32 seconds on the floor — no cold clinical room. Spatial lighting and a guided flow make assessment feel premium, not intimidating.

media.alt: Member body scan session in a premium gym

blocks.title: Reports they actually read
blocks.body: Visual body maps, trend lines, and plain-language insights — designed for retention conversations, not lab printouts.

chapters.title: Data that drives renewals, not dashboards.

blocks.title: Coach-ready from day one
blocks.body: Session notes, risk flags, and progress snapshots export to your workflow — so trainers lead with evidence, not guesswork.

blocks.title: Built for multi-site operators
blocks.body: Roll out across MENA and Southeast Asia with centralized reporting, role-based access, and deployment support.

blocks.title: Validated against DEXA
blocks.body: R=0.96 correlation on core composition metrics — medical-grade rigor in a format gyms can operationalize daily.

blocks.title: Certified for operator trust
blocks.body: CE marking, ISO 13485 quality systems, and cloud security practices aligned with member data protection expectations.
